permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: workflow-feature-pr-gate-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Build and test workflow feature set on Heaven
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, mhw-mods]
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact pull request head
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify pinned .NET SDK
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = (& dotnet --version).Trim()
          if ($version -ne '10.0.401') { throw "Workflow gate requires .NET SDK 10.0.401; found $version." }

      - name: Restore workflow projects
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          dotnet restore .\src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          dotnet restore .\tests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          dotnet restore .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Build workflow product and tests
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          dotnet build .\src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj -c Release --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          dotnet build .\tests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests.csproj -c Release --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          dotnet build .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -c Release --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Run focused UX and XAML regressions
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          dotnet test .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false --filter "FullyQualifiedName~UxHardeningTests|FullyQualifiedName~XamlBindingSafetyTests"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Run legacy migration regression
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          dotnet test .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false --filter "FullyQualifiedName~LegacyMigrationTests"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Run focused workflow regressions
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          dotnet test .\tests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false --filter "FullyQualifiedName~WorkflowTests|FullyQualifiedName~AutomationServiceTests"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Check patch whitespace
        shell: powershell
        run: git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
